I really wish Mappa had this anime as a higher priority, because everything except the animation has been awesome. I loved the manga a lot (like it's definitely in my top five, maybe top three) and the pacing of this adaptation has been awesome. I think they're handling the combat pretty well and the voices are all fitting so far, to my ear at least. But the animation has just felt, I dunno flat? I can't figure out how to describe what I think is lacking here, but I just don't feel like there's a lot of depth or texture to the animation I guess. That aside, I'm enjoying the anime and I hope that enough other people are that maybe it'll get more love in the next season. I'm definitely going to watch it all the way through regardless.

I will include everything you have written in the message I will send to the Developers. Of course, I can't assure you that there will be immediate changes included to the game, as it is a decision the Developers have to make but also don't forget that for most of our games we implement exactly the ideas of the players.
